translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye ma jachul kuor,
yaye Nyasaye ma jachul kuor, nyis lerni.
Aa malo, yaye Jangʼad bura mar piny;
chul josunga gima owinjore kodgi.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nyaka karangʼo ma joma timbegi richo,
nyaka karangʼo ma joma timbegi richo biro goyo siboi?
Gidiro weche mag wich teko;
joma timbegi richo duto opongʼ gi sunga.
Gikidho jogi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
gidiyo girkeni mari.
Ginego dhako ma chwore otho gi jadak;
gideyo ngʼama onge gi wuon.
Giwacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok ne;
Nyasach Jakobo ok dew gik ma watimo.”
To winjuru, un joma omingʼ e dier ji;
un joma ofuwogi, ubiro bedo mariek karangʼo?
Donge ngʼama nochomo it winjo wach?
Donge ngʼat manoloso wangʼ neno?
Donge ngʼat marieyo ogendini kumo ji?
Bende ngʼat mapuonjo dhano dibed maonge rieko?
Jehova Nyasaye ongʼeyo pach dhano;
ongʼeyo ni gionge tich.
Ogwedh ngʼat mikumo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
ma en ngʼama ipuonjo koa e chikeni;
imiyo ngʼama kamano resruok e ndalo chandruok,
nyaka chop kuny bur ne joma richo.
Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ok bi dagi joge;
ok obi jwangʼo girkeni mare.
Yor adiera biro yudore kendo ne joma kare,
kendo joma oriere gie chunygi biro luwe.
En ngʼa mabiro radona gi joma timbegi richo?
Ngʼatno mabiro chwaka kakedo gi joricho?
Ka dine Jehova Nyasaye ok omiya kony,
to dikoro asedhi dak e piny ma ji olingʼe thi.
Kane awacho niya, “Tienda kier,”
to herani nojola, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
Ka achiedh-nade nopongʼo chunya,
to hochni noduogo mor e ngimana.
Loch marach bende inyalo riworigo adier,
loch mamiyo ji chandore malit nikech chikene maricho?
Ginywako ne joma kare
kendo gingʼadone joma onge ketho buch tho.
To Jehova Nyasaye osebedo ohingana,
kendo Nyasacha en lwanda ma aponde.
Obiro chulogi nikech richogi
kendo obiro tiekogi nikech timbegi maricho;
Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa biro tiekogi.
